title: TACIT: Optimization Models that Learn from Their Mistakes
abstract: arXiv:2609.38434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world optimization problems are difficult to model accurately because many objectives and constraints reside in domain experts' tacit knowledge, making them hard to formalize. As a result, optimization models often contain miscalibrated objectives, missing constraints, or omitted decision variables, leading to solutions that fail to reflect operational realities. We address this challenge by automatically repairing misspecified formulations using historical data consisting of past solutions and subsequent user overrides. Traditional approaches such as inverse optimization and constraint learning tend to overfit sparse data and produce complex formulations. translated_title: TACIT：从错误中学习的优化模型
translated_abstract: 现实世界的优化问题难以准确建模，因为许多目标和约束存在于领域专家的隐性知识中，使其难以被形式化。因此，优化模型往往包含校准不当的目标、缺失的约束或被遗漏的决策变量，导致求得的解无法反映真实的运营情况。为应对这一挑战，我们利用由过去的求解方案及用户随后修改所组成的历史数据，自动修复表述失当的模型。逆优化和约束学习等传统方法容易在稀疏数据上过拟合，并产生复杂的模型表述。我们的核心思想是将大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力和先验知识与优化方法提供的形式化基础相结合。我们通过两种互补的范式来实现这一想法：自顶向下，LLM提出结构性修复，包括新增约束和变量……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TACIT，将大语言模型的推理能力与先验知识和优化的形式化基础相结合，利用历史求解数据与用户修改记录自动修复优化模型中目标失准、约束缺失等错误表述。
en_tdlr: TACIT combines the reasoning power and prior knowledge of LLMs with formal optimization grounding to automatically repair misspecified optimization models from historical data of past solutions and user overrides.
